description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides basic endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info. The class is annotated for Swagger documentation and handles HTTP GET requests for different paths.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for welcome message, documentation redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message string when accessed via GET /.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Builds a URL to Swagger UI and redirects to it, preserving the request scheme, host, and port.

methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating application health.
